answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind every agent to a stake-and-rent escrow whose cost returns only through sustained honest service. To keep the cipher key that renews its identity, an agent must have paid rent, completed audited jobs, and been vouched for by peers. A thousand fakes thus owe a thousand stakes and rents, earning nothing until each endures the same queue honest newcomers face. Correlated funding paths also cluster the swarm like debris piling against a jetty, so multiplying identities is no longer free but a paid entry into a hostile ocean.
